subject: SUM clause
notes: kb/Work PB924 (2026-09-22). --check 13.18.54.3 "Otherwise, SUM refers to the report writer SUM clause" -> OK 9). SUM carries subscriptTrigger for the keyword-omitted intrinsic SUM(...) (8.4.3.2.3 SR2), and the lexer pushed SUBSCRIPT mode at the '(' after a bare SUM everywhere, so `SUM (WS-K * WS-M)` in a report description entry died at the token inside the parens. SR9's discriminator is the REGION: the lexer now tracks the REPORT SECTION (opened by its header, closed by the next section/division header) and a SUM there no longer triggers SUBSCRIPT, so the '(' is an arithmetic LPAREN and the addend parses through reportValueOperand. FUNCTION SUM( stays FNARG_LPAREN in the report section, and the keyword-omitted SUM(...) outside it still captures (both arms pinned by the drift tests and the 2023 golden). Editions 85+: the report writer SUM clause with an expression addend is an 85 construct (PB883).
